t: The Nebo Blueline Rechargeable LED Inspection Flip Light delivers high-performance lighting for inspection and trade work. Producing up to 900lm, it features a COB worklight with dual-band UV for leak detection and detailed visual checks. The 180° pivoting head, strong magnetic base, and folding hook allow flexible, hands-free positioning in tight or awkward spaces. Built with an aluminium body, IPX4 splashproof rating, and USB-C charging, it offers durability and reliability for workshop, site, or vehicle use. Run time varies depending on selected light mode: Turbo (900lm for 30 seconds), High (400lm for 5 hours), Low (40lm for 5 hours), and Flashlight (30lm for 14 hours).
